mapper.select: /* buyer.mpso.selectBuyerMpSoPrApprList */ SELECT X.BUYER ,X.PR_NO ,X.PURCHASER_DEPT ,X.APPR_0 ,X.APPR_0_NM ,X.APPR_0_TEL ,X.APPR_0_DEPT ,X.APPR_1 ,X.APPR_2 ,X.DOCU_TITLE ,NVL(X.DOCU_CONT,' ') AS DOCU_CNT ,X.REF_NO FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.PURCHASER_DEPT , A.ADD_USER_ID AS APPR_0 , A.ADD_USER_NAME AS APPR_0_NM , A.ADD_USER_TEL AS APPR_0_TEL , A.ADD_USER_DEPT AS APPR_0_DEPT ,(SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C004' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND COD.CODE = A.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS APPR_1 ,(SELECT COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C004' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND COD.CODE = A.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS APPR_2 ,(SELECT '[구매발주]'||C.DOCU_TITLE FROM ICOMTRGW B, ICOGDOCU C WHERE B.COM_CODE = C.COMPANY AND B.TARGET = C.DOCU_NO AND B.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = A.PR_NO) AS DOCU_TITLE ,(SELECT C.DOCU_CONT FROM ICOMTRGW B, ICOGDOCU C WHERE B.COM_CODE = C.COMPANY AND B.TARGET = C.DOCU_NO AND B.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = A.PR_NO) AS DOCU_CONT ,(SELECT MAX(DT.REF_NO) FROM ICOMPRDT DT WHERE DT.BUYER = A.BUYER AND DT.PR_NO = A.PR_NO) REF_NO FROM ICOMPRHD A WHERE A.BUYER = #{COMPANY} AND A.PR_NO = #{KEY_1} ) X WHERE (X.APPR_1 IS NOT NULL OR X.APPR_2 IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMTRGW TRGW WHERE TRGW.COM_CODE = X.BUYER AND TRGW.DOC_NAME ='PX' AND TRGW.KEY_1 = X.REF_NO )
